reviews.title: Can’t access anything
reviews.text: While it does allow you to have some access to what is due, ect., you only have half the functions of the actual Brightspace website. Meaning for most assignments you still have to go online and do the whole login. So to be clear you can’t upload or submit your assignments on it

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Suddenly getting endless email notifications for class submissions of class im not in in Spanish only

reviews.title: Worst Learning Platform App to Date
reviews.text: This app is all-around terrible. Notifications come very late, and almost all features can’t be opened in the app and require you to go to your outside browser, so have to re-sign in every time. You cannot view grades, submit assignments, or view posts from teachers (which one would think is the entire point of an app like this). The app is pretty much useless except for viewing pdfs, and it is ridiculous that my well-endowed university uses such barebones technology in 2026.

reviews.title: Worthless
reviews.text: This product is inferior to blackboard. This app will not let you do any of the course admin elements that the blackboard instructor app will let you do. Our university switched to the Brightspace product. It is widget based, but has no other advantage whatsoever.  Inferior in every way.

reviews.title: Doesn’t Work
reviews.text: The app is advertised as working with Kaplan UK, but attempting to log in leaves you stuck in the login portal with no way to return to the app.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: This app used to be clutch my first semester of college and then it just working out of no where after that first semester 2025-2026 and now I’m a sophomore and it still doesn’t work like fix this app so I can keep up with my work

reviews.title: Updates to website suck
reviews.text: The updates to the website make it virtually impossible to view a pdf within the website and requires to open in separate tab or make full screen. stupid. There is also no web support or chat to reach out to, lame. I would give a 0 if i could

reviews.title: Limited functionality and outdated interface
reviews.text: Brightspace is easier to use than blackboard, but that is faint praise. Unfortunately, the users of of these products usually have no say in choosing them.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE. NON FUNCTIONAL. HOW IS THIS 5 STARS
reviews.text: This app is completely useleless. None of the features work properly. Nothing loads. Youre far better off logging in on your browser on your phone. Genuinely shocked the reviews are 5 stars.

reviews.title: What’s the point?
reviews.text: The app works for the most part but majority of the tabs that are available on the desktop version are not here. More than this I don’t understand the point of having an app for brightspace if every other things that I want to open in the app just redirects me to the webpage. I might as well just have the webpage on my phone instead of the app.

reviews.title: Optimal View.
reviews.text: Needs to be set up for a phone view as well. Not just something to click on and be able to get to. Allow us to get things done via Phone.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text:
Doesn’t work, but the app does admit that logging into some institution can get stuck in browser mode and you have to contact that schools help desk. 

I am however lazy, and will just be using a browser to complete my course.

Should work without me calling tech support. 

Thanks

reviews.title: Actually probably the worst education app ever.
reviews.text: Maybe it is my professors and I still not being used to this new app but Brightspace is leagues behind both Canvas and the new Blackboard. Discussions not showing up whatsoever is a complete dealbreaker. Hell I can’t even find them in all the confusing things this app has

reviews.title: Unorganized and can’t use discussions
reviews.text: The app is nothing close to the website and very unorganized. There is no place to do discussions without taking you off of the app. Very hard to do homework from an iPad. I don’t know how this is so highly rated with the big confusion and all the redirection off of the app.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Half of the actions open in a browser window. The other half don’t work. Canvas is infinitely better.

reviews.title: Can’t connect
reviews.text: It would be cool if I could use it!

reviews.title: Brightspace needs to be fixed
reviews.text: I have used various platforms for school such as Google Classroom, canvas, etc. This has by far been the worse one. The set up is very awkward and hard to navigate to. It misses a lot of the helpful and user friendly features that canvas has. Often times Brightspace has course material hidden in a link that’s hidden in a folder that’s hidden in another folder that’s under a category. The navigation in Brightspace is atrocious and needs to be fixed.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: It simply doesn’t work, never has. Advertisements all over the learning platform pushing to get the app but it doesn’t work. It opens a browser within the app, you log in and navigate it like the website. It doesn’t save the login. No notifications. Just using chrome is better than this. Support bats you back to the institution that has the D2L instance running it’s just poor all round. Multiple devices have been used and still nothing.

reviews.title: Grades
reviews.text: My grades are not uploading and some of my completed assignments are showing undone.

reviews.title: App Useless
reviews.text: What is the point of the app if it takes you to webpages for everything

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: App connected to the website and website is not working. I can’t check my schedule, I can’t make any payments, can check my grades, can’t do anything. The worst part about that it’s been two months since their website is not working and no one wants to fix it. They were sending messages and alerts that they gonna do some works about it from June 30th to July 1st but nothing changed. You cannot properly use an app if their website is down. Horrible. Fix the website .

reviews.title: Very limited access
reviews.text: I don’t like how it has very little access won’t allow me to access the reading/study material. It only shows assignments but it depends what assignments it is.

reviews.title: Good app but I hate…
reviews.text: The reveal feature give me so much anxiety. Just show the grade please

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Terrible since last update

reviews.title: How is it this bad
reviews.text: This is a first party app. How is it so glitchy I keep getting logged out and half the time I can see my grade but can’t clear the notifications, and the other half I can see the grade update on the web but it doesn’t show up in the app for an hour even if I refresh it

reviews.title: Still nothing is viewable IN the app
reviews.text: this app just became a send me to safari when ever I click on something you can't see document details in pulse app.

reviews.title: Kinda clunky
reviews.text: Clicking notifications don’t bring you anywhere other than the dashboard and the app randomly logs you out of everything and bombards the phone before the password manager can ask you to save your password. Honestly brightspace in general is clunky the app is definitely worse than the website but both are not user friendly

reviews.title: Software
reviews.text: Says software is out of date and won’t work. I have the newest software on my phone.

reviews.title: School system sucks
reviews.text: Too complex and difficult to navigate. Clunky gradebook management. Excessive notifications and system performance issues.

reviews.title: Needs lots of improvement
reviews.text: Unfortunately, this app is very useless, it is better to log in the web. Doesn’t allow for you to download any files directly into your device, instead you always have to go on the web. Additionally, they should add some sort of grade calculator? I always have to make my own due to this issue.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Useless app, doesn’t send you a notification before something is due, but will immediately notify you get a 0 on that assignment. Half of the assignments don’t even show up in the app. Useless, might as well just check the website

reviews.title: Needs redesign
reviews.text: Bad UI design, makes accessing assignments, grades, and content unnecessarily complicated

reviews.title: Latest update-broken
reviews.text: The latest update removed my school information. Went in to look up school and no space bar to type the school into the search bar

reviews.title: Canvas is a lot better
reviews.text: I switched from canvas to bright-space because I transferred to a different institution and the experience is a lot different. I don’t like that it’s much harder to find assignments, you can’t play with your grade. They don’t know have an inbox to contact professors inside the website directly instead of opening a different platform to communicate. The layout is really bad in comparison. Some professors just don’t use it don’t lay out their stuff inside they just put everything on their sillabus. Canvas forces professor to input everything and it’s easier for them to do that. I thought the experience was going to improve after a year but it’s still very bad
